content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal replaces the goods-only Materials warranty with a single concise new 15.5 anchored after the final body paragraph of Article 15 (the 15.4 disclaimer), carrying exactly the eight fallback elements: professional and workmanlike Services, software conformance to documentation for 90 days following delivery, a 30-day Services period measured from performance, and repair, replacement or refund — with no "material respects" qualifier, no re-performance, and no preferred-only extras.
